title: Demographics, Income & Schools
intro: Who lives near PARCEL-01 and what they can spend. The subject property's exact location is withheld, so every figure here is measured at City of Los Angeles, Los Angeles County or MSA level and must be read as a market backdrop rather than a trade-area study. A true 1-, 3- and 5-mile ring analysis requires the address.
